text:
Alex W: hey team, new hire here (joined today). I can't accept the GitHub org invite — GitHub shows "You must enable 2FA" even though I enabled TOTP on my account. Tried reloading & incognito. Anyone seen this? Need access to repo redwood/eng-runtime for my first task.
Onboard-bot: :wave: Welcome Alex! If invite is stuck we usually re-send from the admin console. Confirm your GitHub username and whether you're in GitHub SSO for our org. See https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/invites
Maria I: @Alex W can you DM your GitHub handle? Also did you join with the same email we invited? SSO mismatch is common if you used personal email vs work email.
Alex W: I used alexw.personal@gmail.com for the account. The invite email was to alex.w@redwood.ai — I must've logged into the wrong GH account. How do I switch? I prefer not to create new account.
Samir (it-ops): If you have two accounts, you can add the work email as a secondary on your existing account and verify it. Or we can resend the invite to the personal account and convert later. Quick command to check pending invites: `gh api -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" /orgs/redwood-inference/invitations`
Alex W: added the work email and verified it. But still seeing 2FA required error. My 2FA is TOTP (Authy). Screenshot attached.
Ben (org-admin): Looking. Re-sent invite to github handle `alexw`. Also temporarily relaxed SSO enforcement — try accepting now.
Alex W: Accepted! :tada: But I don't have repo access to redwood/eng-runtime.
Maria I: Added you to team `eng-runtime` — should inherit repo perms in a sec. If not, ping me.
Alex W: I can see the repo now, thanks! One last question: do we require hardware-backed 2FA or is TOTP fine?
Samir (it-ops): TOTP is fine. We only require SSO + 2FA. For sensitive infra repos we may ask for a security review and recommend a hardware key later.
Alex W: Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Ben (org-admin): Leaving note: invite sent 1765123456, re-sent 1765123600, added to team 1765123800 — closing thread.
Onboard-bot: If you run into anything else, check #help or DM devex. :robot_face:
